title: Google Willow 延伸練習：三位元重複碼的能力邊界
titleEn: Google Willow extension: the limits of a three-bit repetition code
subcategoryTitle: 量子錯誤更正與邏輯架構

summary: 枚舉多數決失敗事件並說明單一重複碼不能更正所有量子錯誤。
summaryEn: Enumerate majority-vote failures and explain why one repetition code cannot correct arbitrary quantum errors.

scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

steps.checkEn: Enumerate majority-vote failures and explain why one repetition code cannot correct arbitrary quantum errors. Distinguish quantum states, controls, classical records and unobserved quantities.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Willow 研究比較錯誤更正碼的邏輯表現；此處先用三位元模型建立直覺。
knowledge.textEn: Willow research compares logical error-correction performance; this exercise starts with a three-bit model.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 枚舉多數決失敗事件並說明單一重複碼不能更正所有量子錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Enumerate majority-vote failures and explain why one repetition code cannot correct arbitrary quantum errors.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 三位元獨立翻轉率p，完美讀出與解碼下失敗率3p²(1−p)+p³；此碼只保護指定錯誤類型。
knowledge.textEn: For three independent flips with probabilityp and perfect readout/decoding, failure is3p²(1−p)+p³; only the selected error type is protected.

stages.title: 錯誤圖樣與校驗
stages.description: 列000至111的8種錯誤圖樣，標記0/1/2/3個翻轉與解碼決定；區分資料位元和校驗位元。 依案例來源只註記可查證的裝置／方法；另以虛線標出本課新增的簡化假設。
stages.descriptionEn: List all8 error patterns, annotate0/1/2/3 flips and decoding decisions; distinguish data from check bits. Use the source only to label documented devices or methods; mark this exercise's simplifying assumptions with dashed connections.
